reviews.title: AI, Affirmed Incompetence
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with ChatBox AI and, more importantly, with the enormous gap between the capabilities advertised and the service I actually received.

The free trial is so restricted that it is nearly impossible to meaningfully evaluate the product before paying. I purchased the standard plan and quickly discovered that it was still too limited to accomplish what I needed. After repeatedly being presented with higher tiers promising substantially greater capabilities, I skipped Max and upgraded directly to Pro based on those representations.

That was a mistake.

ChatBox AI promotes access to leading AI technologies such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, and others, along with advanced research, image generation and editing, document analysis, and other premium AI capabilities. Consumers can readily see what modern AI technology is capable of producing. When a company advertises access to these technologies and describes its features as advanced or professional, customers reasonably expect the actual product to deliver functionality that reflects those claims.

My experience has been nowhere close.

I have wasted hours trying to complete relatively straightforward tasks, repeatedly correcting instructions and attempting different approaches, only to end up frustrated and without a usable result. A premium AI subscription is supposed to save time and increase productivity—not consume hours accomplishing nothing.

The photo-editing capability has been especially unacceptable.
